description: Take status: queued/running/succeeded/failed + video file, last frame, token spend, and what the take was shot as: model, resolution, ratio, duration and referenceVideoSec (seconds of @clips it was billed for). A Seedance 2.5 draft carries draft: true and final — its live 1080p final, or null; a final carries finishOf, the draft it was made from.
name: take_status
